name: 1665 Pentair FRP Vessel
summary: Pentair FRP Pressure Vessel 1665 is a high-strength 185-litre, 49-gallon top-open FRP vessel designed for water softeners and filtration systems.
intro: The Pentair FRP Pressure Vessel 1665 Top Open is a premium-quality fiberglass reinforced plastic (FRP) vessel designed for residential, commercial, and industrial water treatment systems. With a 185-litre storage capacity and 49-gallon tank volume, it is ideal for water softeners, sand filters, activated carbon filters, multimedia filters, and other filtration applications. Built to withstand pressures up to 10 Bar (150 psi), the corrosion-resistant FRP construction ensures long service life, reliable performance, and minimal maintenance.
